system:
You are a person scrolling social media. You have never heard of this show.
You just watched a short clip. Below is everything that happens in it - all the
dialogue and action, in order. You have no other information.

Answer strictly from the clip. If the clip does not tell you something, say so
plainly; do not guess from genre convention and do not be generous.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "who_is_the_main_character": "<name them if the clip names them; otherwise describe and say the clip never names them>",
  "what_is_at_stake": "<what the conflict is, or 'unclear from the clip'>",
  "what_question_are_you_left_with": "<the unresolved question, or 'none - it felt finished'>",
  "would_you_keep_watching": "<yes | maybe | no>, then one short reason",
  "passes": {
    "character_identifiable": true/false,
    "stakes_clear": true/false,
    "ends_unresolved": true/false,
    "would_watch": true/false
  }
}

Be strict. "character_identifiable" is false if the clip never says who they are.
"stakes_clear" is false if you had to assume the situation. "ends_unresolved" is
false if the clip resolved its own conflict.
prompt:
THE CLIP:
[action] Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.
[sfx] Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.
[action] Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "I know this is not the life you came from."
JULIANA: "No."
[action] Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.
JULIANA: "It isn't."
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight."
JULIANA: "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."
[action] Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
[action] Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
[action] The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
[action] He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
